## Pull request overview This PR extends the IDL grammar/AST to support nested bracket assignment forms (e.g., `v[vd][msb:lsb] = ...`), updates related analysis/codegen to handle the new AST shapes, and modernizes at least one spec operation to use the new syntax. **Changes:** - Update the IDL assignment grammar to allow one-or-more bracket clauses on the LHS and build nested access chains in `to_ast`. - Add/adjust AST helpers and execution/codegen paths to support nested array/range assignment semantics (including special-casing for `X[idx][msb:lsb]` in analyses/codegen). - Add a dedicated arrays test suite and wire it into the Ruby test runner; update `vmv.v.i` spec to use the new nested assignment form. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/test/test_prune.rb | Rename test class/comment to match pruning focus. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/test/test_loops.rb | Rename test class/comment to match loop focus. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/test/test_functions.rb | Rename test class/comment to match function tests. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/test/test_arrays.rb | New parser/AST tests covering nested bracket access and assignment. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/test/run.rb | Add new arrays test file to the test runner. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/passes/find_src_registers.rb | Extend dst-register detection for nested/X-related assignments. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/idl_parser.rb | Regenerated parser code reflecting the updated grammar. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/idl.treetop | Grammar change: unify element/range assignment into repeated bracket form. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/ast.rb | AST updates for nested assignment handling and base-var extraction. | | spec/std/isa/inst/V/vmv.v.i.yaml | Simplify spec operation to use nested range assignment on `v[vd]`. | | backends/cpp_hart_gen/lib/gen_cpp.rb | Emit correct C++ for range assignments (incl. X-register range updates). |

## Pull request overview Copilot reviewed 10 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.
Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1) **tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/ast.rb:2989** * In `AryElementAssignmentAst#execute` for `:bits`, the code now looks up the base name (e.g., `v` for `v[vd]`) and assigns `var.value = ...` on that base symbol. For nested bit assignments like `v[vd][i] = 1`, this will overwrite the entire array variable `v` with a scalar bits value rather than writing back into element `vd`. This needs the same kind of nested write-back as range assignment: compute the new bits value for `lhs`, then write it back through the access chain (e.g., via `write_back_nested(lhs, new_bits, symtab)`). ``` when :bits base_name = T.must(AstNode.extract_base_var_name(lhs)) var = symtab.get(base_name) value_result = value_try do v = rhs.value(symtab) var.value = (lhs.value(symtab) & ~0) | ((v & 1) << idx.value(symtab)) end ```
